tests.name: privative_magnitude_bounded_by_given_power
tests.note: For E=sigma*(1-d)*P, |E| cannot exceed P on the declared domain.

tests.name: total_deprivation_forces_zero
tests.note: At d=1 the remaining enactment is exactly zero.

tests.name: opposite_orientations_have_equal_magnitude
tests.note: Changing orientation changes sign, not magnitude, at fixed d and P.

tests.name: increasing_deprivation_cannot_increase_magnitude
tests.note: If d1<=d2, the magnitude at d2 cannot exceed the magnitude at d1.

tests.name: nonzero_privative_enactment_retains_orientation
tests.note: With P>0 and d<1, E is strictly positive/negative according to sigma.

tests.name: sanctification_equilibrium_is_unique
tests.note: Any fixed point equals repair/(decay+repair) when total rate is positive.

tests.name: sanctification_equilibrium_lies_in_unit_interval
tests.note: The equilibrium lies in [0,1] for nonnegative decay and repair.

tests.name: sanctification_field_points_toward_equilibrium
tests.note: Below equilibrium the field is positive; above it the field is negative.

tests.name: positive_decay_exposes_noncompletion_at_one
tests.note: Expected countermodel: with positive decay, c=1 is not a fixed point.

tests.name: completion_at_one_iff_decay_is_zero
tests.note: For this constant-rate ODE, c=1 is fixed exactly when decay=0.
